muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت), i.e.: O Muhammad.
﴿أُوحي﴾: a past verb whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿إليّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أُوحي﴾.
﴿أنه﴾: أن with what falls within its scope is in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿استمع﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī); and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أن.
﴿نفر﴾: the fāʿil of استمع.
﴿من الجن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿نفر﴾; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أنه استمع﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿فقالوا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿استمع﴾.
﴿إنا﴾: inna is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism.
﴿سمعنا﴾: a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil; and the clause is the khabar of inna.
﴿قرآنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿عجبا﴾: a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿يهدي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو); and the clause is a second attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿قرآنا﴾.
﴿إلى الرشد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يهدي﴾.
﴿فآمنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; آمنا is a past verb and its fāʿil; and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿سمعنا﴾.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آمنّا﴾.
﴿ولن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لن is a particle of negation, subjunctive and future.
﴿نشرك﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "we" (نحن).
﴿بربنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نشرك﴾; and ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أحدا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿نشرك﴾.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وأنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the hāʾ is the ism (noun) of anna; anna with what falls within its scope is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿تعالى﴾: a past verb.
﴿جدّ﴾: fāʿil (agent), and it is muḍāf.
﴿ربنا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿تعالى جد ربنا﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) with no grammatical position.
﴿ما﴾: negating.
﴿اتخذ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir).
﴿صاحبة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أن﴾.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is connective (ṣila).
﴿ولدا﴾: conjoined to صاحبة. And the clause ﴿ما اتخذ...﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of anna; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أنه...ما اتخذ﴾ is nominative (marfūʿ), conjoined to its like in the first ayah.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وأنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the hāʾ is the ism (noun) of anna; anna with what falls within its scope is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿كان﴾: an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb; its ism is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: "he" (هو); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. [Translator's note: so in the source («إن»); the particle here is أنّ.]
﴿يقول﴾: an imperfect verb.
﴿سفيهنا﴾: fāʿil (agent), and it is muḍāf, and ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿على الله﴾: على is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقول﴾.
﴿شططا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e.: "an outrageous saying" (قولا شططا); and the clause يقول is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿وأنّا﴾: the wāw conjoins to what preceded; anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿ظننا﴾: ظن is a past verb, one of the verbs of the heart (afʿāl al-qulūb), and نا is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause ظننا is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿أن﴾: lightened from the heavy (form) (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla); its ism is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).
﴿لن﴾: a particle of negation, subjunctive and future.
﴿تقول﴾: an imperfect verb; and the clause ﴿لن تقول...﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the lightened أن.
﴿الإنس﴾: fāʿil.
﴿والجن﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الإنس.
﴿على الله﴾: على is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقول﴾.
﴿كذبا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an attribute of the maṣdar, its implied form being: "a false saying" (قولا كذبا).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿وأنه﴾: anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its ism (noun); and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf).
﴿كان﴾: an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb.
﴿رجال﴾: the ism of kāna.
﴿من الإنس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رجال﴾; and the clause كان is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أن﴾.
﴿يعوذون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause is the khabar of kāna.
﴿برجال﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعوذون﴾.
﴿من الجن﴾: attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿رجال﴾.
﴿فزادوهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (زادوا is) a past verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is conjoined to ﴿كان رجال﴾.
﴿رهقا﴾: second object.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وأنهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its ism (noun); and the clause is likewise conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿ظنوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna.
﴿كما ظننتم﴾: كما: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an attribute (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar; and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), construed with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿ظننتم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾.
﴿أن﴾: lightened from the heavy (form) (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla); its ism is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).
﴿لن﴾: a particle of negation, subjunctive and future.
﴿يبعث﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾; and the clause ﴿لن يخرج الله...﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أن. [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause in this ayah is ﴿لن يبعث الله أحدا﴾.]
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, the fāʿil of يبعث.
﴿أحدا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and أن with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of ظنوا.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وأنا﴾: the wāw conjoins to what preceded; anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿لمسنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna.
﴿السماء﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فوجدناها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and وجدناها is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ملئت﴾: a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "it" (هي); and the clause is the second mafʿūl bihi. It has also been said: a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿حرسا﴾: tamyīz (specification).
﴿شديدا﴾: a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وشهبا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿حرسا﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وأنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿كنّا﴾: an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism; and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna.
﴿نقعد﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "we" (نحن); and the clause is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾.
﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مقاعد﴾.
﴿مقاعد﴾: an adverb (ẓarf), attached to ﴿نقعد﴾.
﴿للسمع﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an implied element which is an attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿مقاعد﴾, i.e.: "seats existing for listening".
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and من is a conditional noun that puts into the jussive (ism sharṭ jāzim), a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يستمع﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿الآن﴾: an adverb of the present, borrowed for the future; it is attached to ﴿يستمع﴾.
﴿يجد﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿شهابا﴾: the first object of يجد.
﴿رصدا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شهابا﴾; and the condition clause with its apodosis is the khabar of من.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وأنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿ندري﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna.
﴿أشر﴾: there are two ways of construing it: the nominative by an implied verb, on the pattern of ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb), the clause ﴿أريد﴾ then being explicative with no grammatical position. The second way: the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause ﴿أريد﴾ then being in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿أُريد﴾: a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: "it" (هو).
﴿بمن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أُريد﴾.
﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾; and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿أم﴾: an equating conjunction (muʿādila).
﴿أراد﴾: a past verb.
﴿بهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أراد﴾.
﴿ربهم﴾: fāʿil (agent); رب is muḍāf, and هم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿رشدا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿وأنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is the ism (noun) of anna.
﴿منا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿الصالحون﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; and the clause is the khabar of anna.
﴿ومنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar.
﴿دون﴾: an adverb of place, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an implied ﴿قوم﴾, and it is muḍāf.
﴿ذلك﴾: the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿كنا﴾: ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism.
﴿طرائق﴾: the khabar of kāna.
﴿قددا﴾: a naʿt, accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وأنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is the ism (noun) of anna; and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿ظننا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿أن﴾: lightened from the heavy (form) (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla); its ism is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).
﴿لن﴾: a particle of negation, subjunctive and future.
﴿نعجز﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "we" (نحن); and the clause ﴿لن نعجز الله...﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أن; and أن with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of ظن.
﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لن is a particle of negation, subjunctive and future.
﴿نعجزه﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive, with a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is conjoined to ﴿لن نعجز الله﴾.
﴿هربا﴾: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl, its implied form being: "we will never escape Him, fleeing to the sky and going deep into it".

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وأنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the clause likewise being conjoined (maʿṭūf); anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿لما﴾: linking (rābiṭa), or temporal ("when", ḥīniyya).
﴿سمعنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿الهدى﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied fatḥa because pronouncing it is impossible.
﴿آمنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. And the condition clause with its apodosis is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of anna.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنّا﴾.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and من is a conditional noun that puts into the jussive (ism sharṭ jāzim), a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يؤمن﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), and its fāʿil is "he" (هو).
﴿بربه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمن﴾.
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and لا is negating.
﴿يخاف﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil is "he" (هو); the clause لا يخاف is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: "then he does not fear"; and the nominal clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the condition clause with its apodosis is the khabar of من.
﴿بخسا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولا رهقا﴾: conjoined to ﴿بخسا﴾.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وأنا﴾: likewise conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿منّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿المسلمون﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; and the clause is the khabar of ﴿أنّ﴾.
﴿ومنّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a fronted khabar.
﴿القاسطون﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is conjoined to ﴿منّا المسلمون﴾.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and من is a conditional noun that puts into the jussive (ism sharṭ jāzim), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿أسلم﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿فأولئك﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and أولئك is mubtadaʾ.
﴿تحروا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause is the khabar.
﴿رشدا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿وأما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أما is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl).
﴿القاسطون﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw.
﴿فكانوا﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; كانوا is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its ism (noun); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿القاسطون﴾.
﴿لجهنم﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿حطبا﴾ and was put before it.
﴿حطبا﴾: the khabar of kāna.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وألو﴾: likewise conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أنه استمع; أن is lightened from the heavy (form) (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), its ism being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); and لو is conditional. [Translator's note: the quoted word is so in the source; the text of the ayah is ﴿وأن لو﴾ (written وألّو in the muṣḥaf).]
﴿استقاموا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿لو استقاموا...﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أن﴾.
﴿على الطريقة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استقاموا﴾.
﴿لأسقيناهم﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; أسقيناهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ماء is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿غدقا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ماء﴾.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿لنفتنهم﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl), and نفتنهم is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause, the fāʿil (agent) being "we" (نحن), with a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أسقيناهم﴾.
﴿فيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نفتنهم﴾.
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يعرض﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm).
﴿عن ذكر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعرض﴾; and ذكر is muḍāf.
﴿ربه﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿يسلكه﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿عذابا﴾: accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), the original being: "We make him enter into a punishment" (نسلكه في عذاب). [Translator's note: so in the source, with the first-person نسلكه; the ayah reads ﴿يسلكه﴾ (نسلكه is a variant reading).]
﴿صعدا﴾: a naʿt (adjective), accusative.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وأن﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أنه استمع﴾; and anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿المساجد﴾: the ism (noun) of anna.
﴿لله﴾: the lām is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of anna.
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive (nāhiya).
﴿تدعوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn.
﴿مع﴾: an adverb, attached to ﴿تدعوا﴾, and it is muḍāf.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أحدا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿وأنه﴾: likewise conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أنه استمع﴾; anna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿لما﴾: linking (rābiṭa), or a temporal adverb ("when") containing the meaning of condition.
﴿قام﴾: a past verb.
﴿عبد﴾: fāʿil (agent), and it is muḍāf.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿يدعوه﴾: an imperfect verb, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, its implied form being: "he" (هو), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause يدعوه is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "calling (upon Him)".
﴿كادوا﴾: كاد is a past verb, one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba), and the wāw is its ism; the clause كادوا has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. And لما with its condition and its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of anna.
﴿يكونون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the ism of يكون; and the clause is the khabar of ﴿كادوا﴾.
﴿عليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl.
﴿لبدا﴾: the khabar of يكون, accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿قل﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), referring to the Prophet, upon him be peace.
﴿إنما﴾: a restraining and restrained (particle) (kāffa wa-makfūfa).
﴿أدعو﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), with a latent fāʿil, its implied form being: "I" (أنا).
﴿ربي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied fatḥa because of the (vowel) agreement (with the yāʾ); رب is muḍāf, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negating.
﴿أشرك﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "I" (أنا).
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أشرك﴾.
﴿أحدا﴾: mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿قل﴾: likewise a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), referring to the Prophet, upon him be peace.
﴿إني﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿لا أملك﴾: لا is negating, and أملك is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "I" (أنا); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ضرّا﴾.
﴿ضرّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولا رشدا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ضرا﴾: لا is negating, and رشدا is a conjoined noun; and the clause ﴿إني لا أملك﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿قل﴾: likewise a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), referring to the Prophet, upon him be peace.
﴿إني﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿لن﴾: a particle of negation, subjunctive and future.
﴿يجيرني﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) [Translator's note: so in the source; after لن the verb is in fact subjunctive (manṣūb)]; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause لن يجيرني is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿من الله﴾: من is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجيرني﴾.
﴿أحد﴾: the fāʿil of يجيرني.
﴿ولن﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿لن يجيرني﴾; and لن is a particle of negation, subjunctive and future.
﴿أجد﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative [Translator's note: so in the source; after لن it is subjunctive], its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "I" (أنا).
﴿من دونه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أجد﴾; دون is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ملتحدا﴾: the first object of ﴿أجد﴾.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿بلاغا﴾: a badal (substitute) of ﴿ملتحدا﴾, or an excepted (mustathnā), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿من الله﴾: من is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿بلاغا﴾.
﴿ورسالاته﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and رسالات is a conjoined (maʿṭūf) noun; it is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يعص﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ورسوله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and رسوله is a conjoined noun; it is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ binds the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿نار﴾: the postponed ism (noun) of inna, and it is muḍāf.
﴿جهنم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. And the clause ﴿ومن يعص الله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿خالدين﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿له﴾; the governing word of this ḥāl is the omitted (notion of) "being established" (al-istiqrār).
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خالدين﴾.
﴿أبدا﴾: an adverb of time, accusative, likewise attached to ﴿خالدين﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿حتى﴾: a particle of commencement (ḥarf ibtidāʾ).
﴿إذا﴾: a future adverb containing the meaning of condition.
﴿رأوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, because pronouncing it is impossible, on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يوعدون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; since the verb is passive, the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent)]; and the clause ﴿يوعدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فسيعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is linking, in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the sīn is a particle of the future; يعلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أضعف﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿ناصرا﴾: tamyīz (specification).
﴿وأقل﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أضعف﴾.
﴿عددا﴾: tamyīz.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).
﴿إن﴾: negating.
﴿أدري﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "I" (أنا).
﴿أقريب﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and قريب is a fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿ما﴾: maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿توعدون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾ and ﴿توعدون﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿توعدون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾. Or ﴿ما﴾ may be a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, the clause ﴿توعدون﴾ being the ṣila of the relative noun with no grammatical position.
﴿أم﴾: connected (muttaṣila).
﴿يجعل﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative.
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ربي﴾: fāʿil, nominative, the sign of its nominative being an implied ḍamma because of the (vowel) agreement (with the yāʾ); it is muḍāf, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أمدا﴾: the first object of يجعل; and the clause, suspended (muʿallaqa) by the interrogative, is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of ﴿أدري﴾.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿عالم﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "He is the Knower", or a badal (substitute) of ربي; and it is muḍāf.
﴿الغيب﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, to make the non-disclosure follow upon His being alone in knowledge of the unseen absolutely; and لا is negating.
﴿يظهر﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿على غيبه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يظهر﴾; غيب is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أحدا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) of أحد.
﴿ارتضى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿فإنه﴾: the fāʾ is causal, inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿من بين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسلك﴾; and بين is muḍāf.
﴿يديه﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); يدي is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ومن خلفه﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿من بين يديه﴾; خلف is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿رصدا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); and the clause يسلك is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿إنه﴾, i.e.: "He sends (lit. makes go) guarding angels".

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ليعلم﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl), and يعلم is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسلك﴾, or to an omitted element.
﴿أن﴾: lightened from the heavy (form) (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla); its ism is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).
﴿قد﴾: a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq).
﴿أبلغوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw of the plural; and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿رسالات﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the kasra in place of the fatḥa; and it is muḍāf.
﴿ربهم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); رب is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿قد أبلغوا...﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أن.
﴿وأحاط﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and أحاط is a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما: a relative noun in the position of the genitive; both are attached to ﴿أحاط﴾.
﴿لديهم﴾: لدى: an adverb, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. لدى is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وأحصى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أحصى is a past verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿كل﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative; and it is muḍāf.
﴿شيء﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
﴿عددا﴾: tamyīz (specification) converted from the object, i.e.: "He has counted the number of everything". It has also been said: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿كل شيء﴾, i.e.: "being counted"; or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it has the meaning of "counting" (إحصاء).
